model.title: Aviation Medication Transparency Act of 2025
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. Tammy Duckworth (D-IL)

summary.text: The bill would require the FAA to create and publish an official list of medications that pilots and air traffic controllers can safely take while maintaining their medical certification. Currently, the FAA only maintains private lists of medications to avoid, so this measure aims to provide transparency by making an approved medications list publicly available on the FAA website and distributing it to those applying for pilot and controller licenses.
